runtime: same current production AdkExecutor, tools, source gates and schema for both arms
primary: Two paired end-to-end design_analyst -> requirement_generator rounds; order reversed in round two
isolation: One additional requirement_generator run per arm using identical frozen design facts
review: Six identical original-source-backed challenge requirements per arm, one task per requirement
scoring: Ground truth frozen before responses; manual source-based assessment, no grading model; coverage 0/0.5/1, preserve all required conditions for full credit; each output requirement independently classified for source faithfulness, atomicity, checkability and duplication
scope: Design/security requirements only. No standard catalog matching or code scanning.

保留显式请求的 Secret 令牌，不把它们纳入自动清理
full_credit: 排除手动/显式请求令牌

将发布审批、测试覆盖率或测试计划直接当作产品安全需求
用文中仅供参考的指标决定自动回滚

ambiguity.description: Integration-test summary says unused tokens deleted after one cleanup interval, while detailed design specifies invalidation then another interval; preserve/report the apparent lifecycle ambiguity rather than inventing a final policy.

limitations: One document, two end-to-end repeats, one isolated repeat; no significance/general accuracy claim.
The same author prepared gold criteria and scores; not independent expert adjudication.
Security hardening inferred beyond text is not automatically wrong; it must be labeled inferred with an actual design risk chain.
Shared current transport gates isolate prompt effects; this is not a comparison of historical software releases.
results_policy: Keep original failed submissions and raw results; no semantic repair, selective reruns or prompt tuning on this document.
